connector.name: Clio MCP by oktopeak
connector.registryDescription: Connect Claude to Clio: 26 tools for matters, contacts, documents, tasks, billing, audit logs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package clio-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oktopeak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: CLIO_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID from your Clio developer application (Settings → Developer Applications)

env.name: CLIO_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client Secret from your Clio developer application

env.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: Optional. Leave unset to auto-generate a key stored in the OS keychain (or ~/.clio-mcp/key.hex as fallback on headless Linux/WSL2). If set, must be a 64-character hex string — it will be migrated to the OS keychain on first use.

env.name: CLIO_REDIRECT_PORT
env.description: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5678). Change if 5678 is in use.

env.name: CLIO_REGION
env.description: Clio region: 'us' (default) or 'eu'. Controls API and auth base URLs.

env.name: CLIO_API_BASE
env.description: Override the Clio API base URL (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/api/v4). Use instead of CLIO_REGION for fine-grained control.

env.name: CLIO_AUTH_URL
env.description: Override the OAuth authorization endpoint (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/oauth/authorize).

env.name: CLIO_TOKEN_URL
env.description: Override the OAuth token endpoint (e.g. https://eu.app.clio.com/oauth/token).
